title: Spike: language group fields and index through the real publish path
description: In a sandbox backend: add language and languageGroupId to Item with a languageGroupId+language index, create one Spanish localization lineage beside its English primary, publish both through publish_item and the projection, and measure invalidation paths per publish against maxInvalidationPaths. Confirm per-lineage approvals keyed by content hash keep the languages separate. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Design review of the publish path (no writes): option B fits publish_item and the projection per lineage, with three required changes: language in typeStatus/sectionStatus/headStageKey (else English listings include translations), localization ids {primaryLineageId}--{lang} instead of item_id_for(section, slug) (a Chinese localization sharing the English slug would collide), and a language filter on the seven itemBySlug call sites. The trigger must be a durable record written where announce_published runs (no stream on Item; announce_published swallows errors). Invalidation paths per publish move to Slice 1 (sandbox). Folded into PPY-9b4f52.
